_schema._comment: cases_index.json — the read-model roster of every case study in the corpus. Written by case-publish (append) and seeded from standards_spine.json cases[]. Read by case-brainstorm (dedupe), case-track (assignable catalogue) and the app.

fields.id: string, slug. Stable primary key. Matches the folder name under cases/<id>/ for pipeline cases.
fields.title: string. The 1-3 word evocative case title, exactly as it appears in the title block and in standards_spine.json cases[]. This exact string is what goes into covered_by[].
fields.status: enum: concept | draft | researched | qa | published | legacy | retired. 'legacy' = present in the corpus, not authored by this pipeline. 'published' = passed case-qa with 0 BLOCKERs and packaged by case-publish.
fields.source: enum: corpus | pipeline. Where the case came from.
fields.tier: enum or null: T1 | T2 | T3 | T4 (SPEC.md section 3). null = unknown, never guessed.
fields.band: array of strings, e.g. ['MS-core'] or ['MS-stretch','HS-entry']. Empty = unknown.
fields.studio: enum or null: MS Adventure | Launchpad | both.
fields.primary_metric: string or null. The single quantity the balance test is measured on.
fields.options: object {A, B}. The two one-line options from the Dilemma. null members = unknown.
fields.margin_pct: number or null. How much the better option wins by on primary_metric. SPEC section 2: must be <= ~20 to pass the balance test.
fields.standards_count: integer. Count of spine skills this case exercises.
fields.domains_touched: array of domain names from standards_spine.json.
fields.new_coverage_count: integer or null. Skills that had n == 0 before this case. Non-empty is the reason a pipeline case exists. null for legacy (unknowable retroactively).
fields.qa_verdict: enum or null: PASS | BLOCKED. Set by case-qa, read as a gate by case-publish.
fields.paths: object of repo-relative paths plus an optional Google Drive URL.

invariants: title must appear verbatim in standards_spine.json cases[] once the case is published — that string is the join key into covered_by[].
status 'published' requires qa_verdict == 'PASS' and a non-null published_on.
Unknown values are null. They are never filled with a plausible guess.
